regime_context: The TSX detector shows a broad, non-directional rotation with Energy (Oil & Gas) as the clear leader and Gold Miners as the nearest challenger, but momentum rank is an attention lens only (rank-IC ~0) and the one validated edge is drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate. Given the track record's poor directional accuracy (0.343) on a 99-call history, I keep conviction low and offer only a couple of cautious, falsifiable leans.
emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed leadership handoff from Oil & Gas to Gold Miners: I would retire this watch only if Gold Miners' rank overtakes Oil & Gas AND maintains a durability_bar above 0.5 for two consecutive weeks while Oil & Gas falls out of the top rank. Until that joint condition appears, this remains a display-only rotation read, not a call.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the highest-momentum eligible theme (rank 1, score 1.612) with above-median durability (0.68) and broad internal breadth (0.786), and it passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true). Crowding (z=1.04, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. The one-narrative flag is false, so this is not a crowded everything-in-one trade; a mixed hurst and low rotation absorption (0.31) suggest the move is not yet exhausted.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank has no forward return edge historically, and the crowding flag plus mixed hurst tag mean this leadership could stall or churn without further upside — the rank is attention, not alpha.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX benchmark by 5% or more before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners rank second (score 1.11) and pass the trend gate (eligible=true), but breadth is weak at 0.267 — the move appears narrow and momentum-driven rather than broadly supported. Durability (0.48) is mid-range. This is a conditional lean that the trend continues, but only while the gate holds.
theses.dissent: The narrow breadth (0.267) and mixed hurst mean this theme may mean-revert rather than trend, and the detector offers no return-forecast edge.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO drops below its absolute-trend gate and turns eligible=false before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
